questions.Description:
Carry out the following operations.
a. Direct operation of a single Acting cylinder using pneumatic kit.
b. Direct operation of Double Acting cylinder using hydraulic kit

Carry out the following operations.
Operations of Single and double Acting Cylinder controlled from two different positions using shuttle valve/quick exhaust valve.

Carry out the following operations.
a. Direct operation of Double Acting cylinder.
b. Direct operation of hydraulic Motor.

Carry out the following operations.
a. Speed control of Double Acting cylinder - Using metering-in and metering-out control.
b. Speed control Hydraulic Motor - Using metering-in and metering-out control.

Carry out the following operations.
Automatic operation of two Double Acting cylinder in following sequencing using Pressure sequence valve

Carry out the following operations.
Operation of a Double Acting cylinder using solenoid operated Directional control valve.

Carry out the following operations.
Speed control of Double Acting cylinder using metering in and metering out circuit.

Carry out the following operations.
Automatic operation of Double Acting cylinder in multi cycles-Using limit switches and memory valves

Carry out the following operations.
a. Direct operation of a Pneumatic cylinder using solenoid valve and latch circuit.
b. Direct operation of a hydraulic cylinder using solenoid valve and latch circuit.

Carry out the following operations.
a. Operation of a pneumatic/hydraulic cylinder using AND logic control.
b. Operation of a pneumatic/hydraulic cylinder using OR logic control.

Carry out the following operations.
a. On-delay timer control of pneumatic/hydraulic cylinder
b. Off-delay timer control of pneumatic/hydraulic cylinder.

Carry out the following operations.
Automatic operation of Two Double Acting pneumatic cylinder in multi cycles Using proximities in the following sequence
i.)  A+B+A-B   ii) A-B+A+B

Carry out the following operations.
Wire and test the sequential operation of solenoid valve and a motor for tank filling operation using PLC.

Carry out the following operations.
Develop and execute the ladder logic to interface PLC with conveyor model for counting the object moving in the conveyer
